description: Clean up to 50,000 addresses a call (an input size per request, not a volume cap: send more in further calls or as a background job) with quick checks (no mail server is contacted): returns `keep`, `review` (role, free, parked, new or typo addresses, with a reason) and `remove` (cannot receive mail), plus `counts`. $0.001 per well-formed address. Run email_verify on the kept addresses you will actually send to.

emails.description: The addresses to clean, up to 50,000 a call (an input size per request, not a volume cap: send more in further calls or as a background job); what the request time does not reach comes back in not_checked, free.
